name: @estate/service-notifications
description: Notifications service (M9): the isolating boundary for delivery carriers (docs/01 §2.10, TB5). Internal-only routes — vault/settlement send, identity feeds the recipient store at the two plaintext-email moments. Content-free by construction: the wire carries ids, a closed kind enum, and an optional deadline; templates contain no user data and NO links (docs/03 §5.4, risk #10). Recipient addresses are the service's one Zone B enclave, encrypted under its own 'notifications/kek' on the core cluster; every decrypt is a logged event. Email (SES) is the only live channel this milestone.
